name: ImperfectiveNLI
license_note: The upstream GitHub repository does not currently expose a root LICENSE file. This repository therefore records the dataset terms exactly as reported by the source paper and keeps the dataset outside the project software license.
note: Run scripts/fetch_imperfective_nli.py. The downloader uses the immutable upstream commit, verifies the exact Git blob SHA-1 and byte count, and writes a local SHA-256 manifest.
